transfer_from_invoked.meaning: spender invokes transferFrom(from, to, amount) on TokenWrapper using an allowance

from_is_holder.meaning: the from parameter identifies the actual token holder whose balance is debited

event_from_address.meaning: the from address recorded in the emitted Transfer event log

holder_address.meaning: the actual token holder whose balance decreases (the from parameter)

indexer_attribution_correct.meaning: indexers and analytics attribute the trading activity to the actual user rather than to router contracts or operators
indexer_attribution_correct.checkpoint: after off-chain indexing of the Transfer event

assumptions: Off-chain systems and smart contract integrations rely on Transfer events to attribute token movements to the correct sender.
The spender is a legitimate allowance user; no unauthorized-call condition is claimed.
Internal balances are updated correctly; no on-chain balance loss or theft is claimed.

unresolved.description: The impact's attribution outcome (indexers attributing activity to router contracts/operators rather than users, tax tools failing to detect transfers) is stated qualitatively with no numeric or structural definition; it is bound as a grounded Boolean observable rather than a derived quantity.

limitations: The impact is stated as potential ('may fail'), so the relation captures the forbidden attribution outcome as a Boolean rather than a proven occurrence.
The correspondence between event_from_address and holder_address is the report's stated EIP-20 requirement; runtime binding of the actual emitted field is deferred.
Only the indexer/analytics attribution impact is formalized; explorer, wallet, and tax-tool impacts are handled in separate passes.
